programme.name: Universal Autonomous Evolution — Evolution Transaction Register
programme.mission: Make autonomous universal evolution a measurable transaction rather than a described intention. Every canonical phase of the perpetual evolution cycle already has a located owner in this repository, and two programmes already measure that fact: UEI-000001 binds each evolution CAPABILITY to the home that realises it, and UCOS-AEE-001 asserts convergence of the LOOP over those homes. Neither produces the thing the loop is supposed to operate on: an identified, evidence-backed evolution object for a specific subject, carried through discovery, understanding, planning, simulation, execution, measurement, validation, verification, certification, learning and state transition, and landed in a history that survives the process that wrote it. This programme is that transaction plane. It discovers evolution candidates from artifacts other owners already produce, derives one evolution object per phase per candidate through the identity rule the nucleus evolution transaction already uses, measures every mandated field, and projects the result through the canonical Article 14 ledger. It creates no evolution model, no lifecycle, no registry, no certifier and no knowledge system.
programme.disclosure: AUTHORITY = NONE. This programme legislates nothing, ratifies nothing, mints no corpus identity, mutates no repository state and owns no capability. Every phase of the loop is bound by pointer to an owner that exists independently of this programme and remains governed by its own authority. Execution is bound to the constitutional mutation gateway and is never performed here: this engine is a measurement and never a second mutation path. Where this register and a canonical owner differ, the canonical owner governs. Certification standing is CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL and cannot exceed the standing of the owners it binds.
programme.non_duplication: No stage of the evolution cycle is declared here; the cycle is read from the canonical stage authority at run time and the gate closes if a canonical stage is not claimed by exactly one phase of this register. No object is registered in a new registry; every evolution object identity is derived by the same content-addressed rule the nucleus evolution transaction already applies. No certificate is issued; certification is a set of proofs over what located owners already determined. No history store is created; the history file is the canonical projection of the Article 14 ledger and is rehydrated through that ledger's own loader, so reading it re-runs the ledger's append rules rather than trusting the bytes.

boundaries.other_subject: the law of the perpetual evolution cycle — which stages exist, in what order, and that none is terminal (UCKP-ART-14 / INV-13)
boundaries.this_subject: one transaction traversing that cycle for one subject
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: This register declares no stage. It reads the stage set from that module and fails closed if a stage it does not claim appears there. A law and an instance of the law are not two authorities over one thing.

boundaries.other_subject: the generational evolution transaction for a registered nucleus subject — generation numbering, supersession, capability monotonicity
boundaries.this_subject: the pre-registration transaction: turning an observed condition into an evolution candidate with a derived identity, before any subject is registered to evolve
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: The identity derivation rule is reused, not reimplemented: the same content-addressed prefix and width. Nothing here assigns a generation, and nothing here writes a nucleus ledger.

boundaries.other_subject: binding each mandated evolution CAPABILITY to the repository home that realises it, and measuring that the binding still resolves
boundaries.this_subject: binding each evolution INSTANCE to the capabilities UEI already located, and measuring that the instance carries every mandated field
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: Capability and instance are different subjects. UEI answers 'can the platform observe, plan, simulate?'. This register answers 'did this candidate get observed, planned and simulated, and where is the evidence?'. Removing either leaves a question no other owner answers.

boundaries.other_subject: convergence of the observation vector produced by re-executing located owners across consecutive iterations
boundaries.this_subject: the evolution objects the loop operates on
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: AEE measures whether the loop settles. This register measures what the loop carried. AEE observes this programme's determination as one more owner verdict; this programme never re-executes AEE and never asserts convergence, so there is no cycle between them.

boundaries.other_subject: the only path by which repository truth may be mutated — the seven-stage proposal pipeline and its monopoly on a clean state seal
boundaries.this_subject: the record that an evolution was authorised to travel that path, and the refusal to offer any other path
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: This engine performs no mutation. Its execution phase measures that a controlled execution owner is bound and resolves; it never proposes, applies or seals. A second mutation path is exactly what this register exists to make visible, not to provide.

boundaries.other_subject: the forty-five stage constitutional lifecycle and its derived ordering
boundaries.this_subject: the lifecycle state carried by one evolution object
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: No lifecycle stage, transition or ordering is declared here. The lifecycle state field names a state the lifecycle owner defines; this register measures its presence, never its meaning.

boundaries.other_subject: issuing certificates against the certification rule suite
boundaries.this_subject: proving that an evolution satisfies the declared conditions of certifiability
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: No certificate is issued here and no certification rule is re-judged. The certification phase measures whether each declared proof holds over the evolution objects; the certificate itself remains the located owner's to issue.

boundaries.other_subject: exactly one disposition per discovered repository unit, and the implementation queue derived from it
boundaries.this_subject: exactly one evolution chain per discovered evolution candidate
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: A unit is a thing that exists; a candidate is a change that does not yet exist. This register consumes RIB's gap measurement as a discovery source and derives no unit, no disposition and no queue.

boundaries.other_subject: byte-level fixed point of the canonical regeneration chain across consecutive rounds and pristine clones
boundaries.this_subject: determinism of this programme's own render, proven by rendering twice in one process
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: This register makes no fixed-point claim about the repository. It proves only that its own output is a function of its own declaration, which is the precondition Phase 8 needs from every producer it measures.

boundaries.other_subject: the separation of Identity Truth from Observation Truth, and which observation kinds may reach a canonical artifact
boundaries.this_subject: the evolution objects derived from observations other owners already recorded
boundaries.why_not_duplicate: No observation kind is declared here and no observation value is minted. Every discovery source is a committed, sealed artifact of a located owner, so what enters this register is that owner's derived truth and not a fresh reading of the working tree.

classifications.meaning: every declared owner home resolves, every declared symbol is bound in it, and a gate is declared and resolves
at least one declared owner home resolves with its symbols, but a declared home, symbol or gate does not
no declared owner home resolves, so the phase has no realisation in repository truth
two phases resolve to an identical owner home set, which would be two authorities over one home
the phase is declared with no owner home at all and is carried as a disclosed absence rather than closed by building a new engine

stage_authority.basis: The stage set is read from this module rather than restated here, so this register cannot drift from the law it claims to traverse. Every stage the module declares must be claimed by exactly one phase below; a stage appended under Article 17 closes this gate until a phase claims it, which is how an open-world cycle stays governed instead of quietly growing an unowned stage.

identity.basis: The identity of an evolution object is the content-addressed digest of what makes it that evolution, truncated to the same width the nucleus evolution transaction already uses. Nothing is minted, no corpus serial is consumed and no registry is written, so this register cannot become a second identity authority. Because identity is derived from meaning rather than from arrival order, the same candidate observed twice yields the same evolution id and the history does not fork.
identity.anonymity_rule: An evolution object whose identity does not match the digest of its own declared inputs, or whose subject identity is empty, is anonymous. Anonymous evolution is refused, not reported.

phases.name: Discover
phases.duty: turn a condition observed by a located owner into an evolution candidate with a reason and a subject
phases.reuse: Discovery is not performed against the working tree. It reads the sealed derived-truth artifacts the repository intelligence engine and the integration blueprint already publish, so a candidate is always attributable to an owner that measured it.
phases.authority: UCOS-RIE-001 — Repository Intelligence Engine (derived truth); discovery may only report what a located owner measured

phases.name: Understand
phases.duty: answer why to evolve, what changes, what depends on it, what can break, and what evidence supports it
phases.reuse: Meaning, relationship kinds and authority tiers are the knowledge model's to define. Understanding here is the composition of the candidate with the dependency and progress measurements those owners publish.
phases.authority: engine/uckp/law.py UCKP-ART-02 — the knowledge model owns meaning, relationship kind and authority tier

phases.name: Plan
phases.duty: produce objectives, steps, dependencies, risk, acceptance criteria and a rollback strategy under the governing authority
phases.reuse: Three planners already exist — realization waves, assurance obligations and the execution plan the mutation gateway certifies against. No fourth planner is written; the plan object records which of them governs each step.
phases.authority: URI-000001 — the realization planning authority, with the assurance policy as the obligation source

phases.name: Simulate
phases.duty: predict impact, validate dependencies and evaluate risk before anything is executed
phases.reuse: Simulation is replay against a candidate state rather than a new predictive engine: the replay owners already prove that executing a plan twice reaches one digest, which is the only impact prediction that can be verified rather than believed.
phases.authority: engine/uckp/law.py UCKP-ART-13 — replay is the only impact prediction that can be verified rather than believed

phases.name: Execute
phases.duty: carry the plan through the single authorised mutation path, under identity, authority, evidence and gates
phases.reuse: The gateway is the only producer of a clean state seal, so it is the only path by which an executed evolution can become repository truth. This register records the authorisation and refuses to offer an alternative; it performs no mutation itself, which is why no bypass can originate here.
phases.authority: UCOS-CMG-EXEC-000001 — the constitutional mutation gateway, sole producer of a clean state seal

phases.name: Measure
phases.duty: observe the result after execution and compare expected against actual, recording the deviation
phases.reuse: The control-plane evolution engine already classifies a delta as promoted, regressed, improved, modified or unchanged against declared orderings. Measurement reuses that classification instead of inventing a verdict word.
phases.authority: UCOS-CTRL-000001 — the universal control plane, which owns delta classification against declared orderings

phases.name: Validate
phases.duty: establish correctness, completeness, consistency, compatibility, traceability and reproducibility of the change
phases.reuse: The assurance orchestrator already stages validation planning, generation, execution and evidence collection and already fails a run whose declared metric could not be measured. No validation dimension is re-implemented; each is bound to it.
phases.authority: UCOS-EPIC-014 — the universal assurance orchestrator, with the UCKP invariant probes beneath it

phases.name: Verify
phases.duty: prove identity, dependency, evidence, governance and lifecycle integrity, and readiness to certify
phases.reuse: Verification is the canonical entry point plus the gates it already runs. This register names which gate discharges which integrity dimension and measures that the gate is wired; it never restates a gate's verdict as its own.
phases.authority: verify.sh — the single canonical verification entry point and the gates it runs

phases.name: Certify
phases.duty: prove the evolution was authorised, understood, planned, executed, evidenced, validated, verified and recorded
phases.reuse: The certification pipeline issues certificates and the assurance layer adapts inputs to it without re-judging. This phase adds only the proofs that are specific to an evolution transaction and could not be expressed as a certification rule over a static object.
phases.authority: UCOS-EPIC-006 — the universal certification pipeline, sole issuer of certificates

phases.name: Learn
phases.duty: assimilate the outcome so the next cycle starts from what this one established
phases.reuse: Assimilation already has an owner and a gate. Learning here is the record of which outcome was assimilated by whom, so that a learned outcome cannot exist without a located assimilator.

phases.name: Evolve
phases.duty: transition state, append the history record, and continue — never terminate
phases.reuse: State transition and continuation are the Article 14 ledger's own semantics. The history this register writes is that ledger's canonical document and is read back through that ledger's loader, so the append-only claim is re-verified on every read instead of being asserted once.
phases.authority: engine/uckp/law.py UCKP-ART-14 — append-only evolution, enforcing UCKP-INV-13

object_kinds.name: Evolution Intent Object
object_kinds.purpose: the recorded intention to evolve one subject for one reason, derived from an owner's measurement rather than from a human feature request

object_kinds.name: Evolution Understanding Object
object_kinds.purpose: why the evolution matters, what it changes, what depends on it, what it can break, and what evidence supports each of those answers

object_kinds.name: Evolution Plan Object
object_kinds.purpose: objectives, steps, dependencies, risk, the criteria each later phase will be judged against, and the rollback strategy

object_kinds.name: Evolution Simulation Object
object_kinds.purpose: the predicted impact, dependency resolution and risk evaluation obtained before execution. Additional to the mandated set: without it, execution would be permitted with no prior evaluation, which the controlled-execution rule forbids

object_kinds.name: Evolution Execution Object
object_kinds.purpose: the record that the plan was carried through the single authorised mutation path under identity, authority, evidence and gates

object_kinds.name: Evolution Observation Object
object_kinds.purpose: the post-execution measurement — expected result, actual result, deviation — attributed to the owner that measured it

object_kinds.name: Evolution Validation Object
object_kinds.purpose: the verdict of each declared validation dimension over this evolution, with the failures that produced it

object_kinds.name: Evolution Verification Object
object_kinds.purpose: the integrity verdicts and the gate that discharges each of them

object_kinds.name: Evolution Certification Object
object_kinds.purpose: the proofs that make this evolution certifiable, and the located owner that would issue the certificate

object_kinds.name: Evolution Learning Object
object_kinds.purpose: what the outcome established and which assimilator holds it. Additional to the mandated set: a loop that cannot record what it learned repeats itself

object_kinds.name: Evolution History Object
object_kinds.purpose: the append-only record of the whole transaction — who, what, why, when in logical time, where, context, evidence, decision, impact, validation, certification

required_fields.name: Evolution ID
required_fields.derivation: the content-addressed digest of the object's declared identity inputs, prefixed and truncated by the identity rule

required_fields.name: Subject Identity
required_fields.derivation: the subject the discovery source named, carried unchanged through every phase so one chain always describes one subject

required_fields.name: Previous State
required_fields.derivation: the condition the discovering owner measured, stated as the state that exists now

required_fields.name: Target State
required_fields.derivation: the condition under which the discovering owner would no longer report this candidate

required_fields.name: Reason
required_fields.derivation: the discovering owner's own words for why the condition is a condition, never a restatement invented here

required_fields.name: Context
required_fields.derivation: the source artifact, the selector within it and the candidate class, so the candidate can be re-derived from the artifact that produced it

required_fields.name: Dependencies
required_fields.derivation: the owner homes this phase binds, plus the phases this phase depends on. May legitimately be empty only for a phase with no declared owner, which is itself a disclosed absence

required_fields.name: Evidence
required_fields.derivation: the resolving artifact paths the phase declared, filtered to those that exist. An evolution object with no resolving evidence is refused

required_fields.name: Plan
required_fields.derivation: the plan objective and the planner that governs it, carried into every downstream object so no phase runs unplanned

required_fields.name: Execution Record
required_fields.derivation: the authorised execution path, its gate, and whether the path resolves. Never an assertion that a mutation happened

required_fields.name: Validation Result
required_fields.derivation: the aggregate verdict of the declared validation dimensions measured over this object

required_fields.name: Verification Result
required_fields.derivation: the aggregate verdict of the declared verification dimensions, each attributed to the gate that discharges it

required_fields.name: Certification Result
required_fields.derivation: the aggregate verdict of the declared certification proofs over this object

required_fields.name: Lifecycle State
required_fields.derivation: the canonical stage this phase claims, taken from the stage authority. A lifecycle state this register invented would be a second lifecycle

discovery_duties.duty: authority surface gaps in this repository's own canonical owners

discovery_sources.name: declared spine gaps
discovery_sources.reason_template: the repository intelligence engine measures this capability as named and not implemented
discovery_sources.target_template: the named capability resolves to a home that exists and the readiness artifact no longer lists it

discovery_sources.name: blocked capability
discovery_sources.reason_template: the execution frontier records this capability as blocked
discovery_sources.target_template: the blocking condition is discharged and the frontier no longer records the block

discovery_sources.name: knowledge and readiness gaps
discovery_sources.reason_template: the readiness determination names this as a reason the platform is not ready
discovery_sources.target_template: the reason is discharged and no longer appears in the readiness determination

discovery_sources.name: integration gap classes
discovery_sources.reason_template: the integration blueprint measures a non-empty gap class
discovery_sources.target_template: the gap class measures zero members

discovery_sources.name: dimension optimization opportunities
discovery_sources.reason_template: the progress measurement records this dimension below full reconciliation
discovery_sources.target_template: the dimension reconciles to its full score without a stale measurement

discovery_sources.name: convergence findings
discovery_sources.reason_template: the autonomous evolution loop records a finding against a located owner
discovery_sources.target_template: the finding is discharged by its owner and the loop no longer records it

discovery_sources.name: critical-path relationships
discovery_sources.reason_template: the critical path declares an ordering relationship this register must carry rather than re-derive
discovery_sources.target_template: the relationship is discharged and leaves the critical path

discovery_sources.name: authority surface obligations
discovery_sources.reason_template: a canonical authority does not expose a surface this register depends on
discovery_sources.target_template: the declared symbol is bound in the declared home

discovery_sources.name: unknown object probe
discovery_sources.reason_template: an object that exists in no registry, bears no declared class and names no known owner must still traverse the loop
discovery_sources.target_template: the unknown object is discovered, identified, understood, planned, executed, validated, verified and certified with no new registry, authority, engine or governance patch

authority_symbols.why: the Article 14 ledger could project itself to a canonical document and could not read one back, so a published evolution history could never be re-verified: the append-only claim was true inside one process and unfalsifiable between processes
a rehydrator that cannot name the schema it accepts will accept any document that happens to have a records array
the identity derivation rule this register reuses lives on that class; if it moves, every evolution id here becomes unattributable
the execution phase binds to a derived pipeline order; a hardcoded order would let a stage be skipped silently
the unknown-evolution proof requires that the stage vocabulary admits a term no stage declares; without this surface the cycle would be a closed set

unknown_probe.subject: uaue.unknown-subject/1.0.0
unknown_probe.subject_class: an object that exists in no registry, bears no declared class, names no known owner and belongs to no reality model this repository has modelled
unknown_probe.basis: The probe is not a test fixture kept beside the code; it is a candidate carried through the same controller as every other candidate. If the controller needed to know what the subject was, the probe would fail — which is exactly the property that must be measured rather than claimed.

self_evolution.gap: the canonical Article 14 evolution ledger exposed no inverse of its canonical projection, so an evolution history could be written and never read back under the ledger's own append rules
self_evolution.previous_state: EvolutionLedger exposes to_document and fingerprint and no loader; EvolutionRecord.from_dict exists but nothing rehydrates a ledger
self_evolution.target_state: EvolutionLedger exposes from_document, which replays every record through append so a skipped, reordered or renumbered record is refused on load exactly as it is refused on write, and LEDGER_SCHEMA names the document form it accepts
self_evolution.basis: This is the programme's own demonstration that the platform can detect a gap in itself, understand it, plan it, execute it through a located owner and have the closure measured for ever after. The measurement stays live: if the surface is removed, this register reopens the candidate and the gate closes.

records.derivation: the located owner home that measured the condition, and the authority the phase resolves under
the subject identity together with the previous and target state
the discovering owner's reason, carried verbatim

the logical position in the perpetual cycle — cycle number, stage, and sequence within the ledger. Never a wall clock: a wall clock would make the history unreplayable and would make this artifact drift on every render
the source artifact and selector the candidate was derived from
the candidate class and the phase that produced the object
the resolving evidence paths of the phase
the classification of the phase and the verdict of the object
the deviation between expected and actual recorded by the measurement phase
the validation verdict of the object
the certification verdict of the object

history.immutability_rule: The history is the canonical document of an append-only ledger and is loaded back through that ledger, so a mutated history is refused on read rather than trusted. Because every record identity is content-addressed, a record cannot be rewritten without changing its identity, and a changed identity is a different record.

validations.obligation: every evolution object's identity equals the digest of its own declared identity inputs
every evolution object carries every mandated field, and every field declared non-empty is non-empty
every canonical stage of the evolution cycle is claimed by exactly one phase, and every phase produces exactly one object kind
every declared owner home resolves in repository truth and every declared symbol is bound in it
every candidate resolves to a discovery source that exists, and every mandated object kind is produced
two renders of one declaration over one repository state are byte-identical

verifications.obligation: no evolution object is anonymous and no two distinct objects share an identity
every phase dependency names an earlier phase, so the loop has no backward edge that would make an object depend on its own successor
every evolution object carries at least one resolving evidence path
every phase names a gate, and every named gate is wired into the repository's verification surface
every object's lifecycle state is a stage the canonical stage authority declares
no phase is classified MISSING or DUPLICATE

certifications.obligation: every object resolves under a named authority and a named gate
every chain produces an understanding object answering why, what, what depends, what breaks and what evidence
every chain produces a plan object and every downstream object carries the plan
every chain's execution object binds the single authorised mutation path and that path resolves
no object carries an empty evidence set
every object carries a measured validation verdict
every object carries a measured verification verdict
every object appears in the history projection and the projection rehydrates through the canonical ledger

exit_criteria.criterion: every capability of the loop is classified against repository truth and the classification matrix is rendered
every mandated evolution object kind exists and carries every mandated field
every declared discovery duty is satisfied by at least one resolving source, and discovery yields at least one candidate
every candidate produces an understanding object answering all five understanding questions
every candidate produces a plan object carrying objectives, steps, dependencies, risk, criteria and rollback
no execution object exists without a preceding simulation object
every execution object binds the single authorised mutation path and no second mutation path is offered
every chain produces an observation object recording expected, actual and deviation
every declared validation dimension is measured and satisfied
every declared verification dimension is measured, satisfied and bound to a wired gate
every declared certification proof is measured and satisfied
the controller traverses every phase for every candidate with no phase-specific or subject-specific branch
the history projection contains every object, rehydrates through the canonical ledger and is queryable by every declared key
the self-evolution subject's gap is measured closed and its required symbols resolve
the unknown-object probe traverses every phase, and the stage vocabulary admits a stage term no stage declares

plan_contract.dependencies_from: phase owner homes and the preceding phase in the loop
plan_contract.risk_from: the severity the discovering owner recorded, defaulting to the candidate class when the source declares no severity
plan_contract.rollback_strategy: Every step of every plan is discharged by a located owner through the constitutional mutation gateway, and the gateway is the only producer of a clean state seal. Rollback is therefore not a compensating action invented per plan: a mutation that fails any gateway stage never reaches truth, so the prior state is not restored but never left. Where a step has already reached truth, rollback is a further evolution of the same subject under the same gateway — which is why this register records no delete path and no out-of-band revert.
plan_contract.basis: The plan is composed from the declaration rather than authored per candidate, so a candidate no owner can plan for cannot silently acquire a plan. Every criterion a later phase will judge the evolution against is named in the plan before that phase runs.
